policies.text: Issuance of an elite protection card is recommended for an individual with elite capital safeguarding option.

Tier-one financial consulting eligibility requires either an investment portfolio balance of at least $150,000, liquid capital of no less than $50,000, and 3 or more yearly site evaluations, or a total high-value asset valuation of $400,000.
Deep-water mooring privilege is granted for a vessel measuring at least 40 meters in length.
Tournament riding eligibility requires an equestrian organization rating of 80 points or higher.

Cultural patron status is conferred when an individual has an art collection valued at $800,000 or higher, holds a protective deposit of at least $25,000, and completes 4 or more annual foundation audits.
Automated access installation is recommended for any client possessing luxury residence access authorization.
Elite cellar distinction is bestowed on a collector maintaining a reserve of 1,000 bottles or more.
High-profile hosting clearance is granted to an individual qualifying for global event backing who also has first-class suite reservation advised.
Global event backing qualification is met either with a builder advisory credential alongside annual corporate backing of at least $50,000, or by holding an active diplomatic VIP credential.
Privileged oceanic vessel charter status is approved for boat owners logging over 200 nautical miles in a single quarter.
First-class suite reservation is advised for an individual with premium flight reservation status who has accumulated an annual balance of at least 40,000 loyalty points.
Luxury residence access authorization requires a client cleared for first-tier safety who has completed at least 5 yearly background checks.

Estate development pre-authorization is conferred either with a minimum property account balance of $40,000 alongside at least 3 yearly site evaluations, or through holding a valid builder advisory credential.
Allocating priority conservation rights is recommended for a recognized historic property steward.
First-tier safety endorsement requires a minimum protective deposit of $25,000 and a valid high-value coverage policy.

Historic property stewardship recognition is granted either with 4 or more annual foundation audits and an investment portfolio balance of at least $150,000, or by holding a valid heritage trustee licence.
Top-tier flight status is awarded to an individual accumulating at least 100 private flying hours annually.
Premium flight reservation status is granted when an individual's yearly travel account balance is at least $10,000 and an active executive travel membership is maintained.
Naming a gallery wing is advised for any recognized cultural patron whose yearly charitable donations reach at least $75,000.
Specialized architectural consulting services are offered to property managers maintaining an annual commercial leasing budget of at least $500,000.
Elite capital safeguarding option is open to a client with tier-one financial consulting eligibility for whom first-class suite reservation is advised.
